assertions.description: HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the replacedByUserAgent attribute (requires the UAImageReplacementAPI origin trial or flag in Chrome 152).
HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the onuareplacestart event-handler attribute.
HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the onuareplaceend event-handler attribute.
When exposed, replacedByUserAgent reads false on a fresh image and is read-only: assignment must not change it (pages never control replacement state).
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (!('replacedByUserAgent' in HTMLImageElement.prototype)) return false; const img = new Image(); if (img.replacedByUserAgent !== false) return false; try { img.replacedByUserAgent = true; } catch (_) {} return img.replacedByUserAgent === false; })()

assertions.description: No function member related to replacement exists on HTMLImageElement.prototype — the API is observation-only; content-driven replacement is an explicit non-goal. Holds in every context.
assertions.test: (()=>{ for (const name of Object.getOwnPropertyNames(HTMLImageElement.prototype)) { if (/replace|uareplace/i.test(name)) { const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLImageElement.prototype, name); if (typeof d?.value === 'function') return false; } } return true; })()

assertions.description: A page-dispatched uareplacestart reaches listeners with isTrusted === false — forged replacement signals are always distinguishable from real ones. Holds in every context.
assertions.test: (()=>{ let e = null; const img = new Image(); img.addEventListener('uareplacestart', (ev) => { e = ev; }, { once: true }); img.dispatchEvent(new Event('uareplacestart')); return !!e && e.isTrusted === false; })()

assertions.description: Trusted uareplacestart/uareplaceend events fire only when a user actually invokes a browser replacement feature — no page-observable side channel may reveal replacement capability without use.
assertions.test: Requires a Chrome build with a real image-replacement feature (e.g. generative try-on) and explicit user use of it: verify the events fire with isTrusted true then, and never before.
